# @ratmath/geo

> Geometry for RatMath: Euclidean constructions, theorems checked on exact figures and proved in general, spherical, hyperbolic, projective and finite geometries, symmetry and tilings. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as geo from "@ratmath/geo"`.

Built from 0.4.0, commit 17b4d74 plus uncommitted changes. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/geo/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/geo/blob/17b4d74/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/geo/. Full types: index.d.ts.

Types: `type Num = Rational | AlgebraicValue`; `type NumLike = Num | bigint | number | string`; `type PointLike = Point | [NumLike, NumLike]`; `type TriangleLike = Triangle | [PointLike, PointLike, PointLike]`; `type PPointLike = PPoint | Point | [NumLike, NumLike] | [NumLike, NumLike, NumLike]`; `type Matrix3 = [[NumLike, NumLike, NumLike], [NumLike, NumLike, NumLike], [NumLike, NumLike, NumLike]]`; `type Point3 = [NumLike, NumLike, NumLike]`; `type WallpaperName = "p1" | "p2" | "pm" | "pg" | "cm" | "pmm" | "pmg" | "pgg" | "cmm" | "p3" | "p3m1" | "p31m" | "p4" | "p4m" | "p4g" | "p6" | "p6m"`; `type FriezeName = "p1" | "p11g" | "p1m1" | "p2" | "p2mg" | "p11m" | "p2mm"`; `type AngleLike = Angle | NumLike | { cos: NumLike; sin?: NumLike }`; `type Vec3Like = [NumLike, NumLike, NumLike]`; `type SPointLike = SPoint | Vec3Like`; `type HPointLike = HPoint | Point | [NumLike, NumLike]`; `type HAny = HPointLike | HIdeal`; `type ExactComplex = [Num, Num]`; `type Scalar = number | bigint | string | Rational`; `type Coordinate = Scalar | GeoExpr`; `type GeoLine = [GeoPoint, GeoPoint]`; `type VectorLike = Vector | [NumLike, NumLike, NumLike] | { x: NumLike; y: NumLike; z: NumLike }`; `type ConicType = "ellipse" | "circle" | "hyperbola" | "parabola" | "point" | "two crossing lines" | "two parallel lines" | "double line" | "empty"`; `type Vertex = number | string`; `type FinitePoint = number | string`

## Example

```js
import { plan, N, circle, meet, triangle, striangle, ideal, htriangle } from "@ratmath/geo";
const t = triangle([0, 0], [4, 0], [1, 3]);
console.log("centroid", String(t.centroid), " circumcentre", String(t.circumcenter), " orthocentre", String(t.orthocenter));
console.log("incentre", String(t.incenter));
console.log("area", N.text(t.area), " circumradius", N.text(t.circumradius), " cos A", N.text(t.cosines.A));
for (const name of ["eulerLine", "ninePointCircle", "feuerbach", "napoleon"]) console.log(theorems[name](t).theorem + ":", theorems[name](t).statement, "→", theorems[name](t).holds);
console.log("two unit circles meet at", meet(circle([0, 0], [1, 0]), circle([1, 0], [0, 0])).join(" and "));
console.log("octant triangle: excess", striangle([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]).excess.text, "  ideal hyperbolic triangle: area", htriangle(ideal(1, 0), ideal(0, 1), ideal(-1, 0)).area.text);
plan.map((p) => `${p.phase}. ${p.contents}`)
```

- tests/: worked examples for every function
